question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Fail to function normally
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Malfunction"** means** to fail to function normally or properly. (**सामान्य रूप से काम न करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The car's engine** malfunctioned **on the highway, causing a traffic jam.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Malfunction**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Maltreat** (दुर्व्यवहार करना): To treat someone or something badly or cruelly.

 
 
• **Example:** It is illegal to **maltreat **animals in many countries.
 
 
 
• **Mangle** (क्षत-विक्षत करना): To severely mutilate, disfigure, or damage by cutting, tearing, or crushing.
 
 
• **Example:** The document was** mangled **in the old printer.
 
 
 
• **Manipulate** (हेरफेर करना): To handle or control something in a skillful manner, often in an unfair or deceitful way.
 
 
• **Example:** He managed to **manipulate** the data to make the results look more favorable.
